name: dapseq

summary.name: dapseq
summary.note: Positives are 201 bp windows centred on DAP-seq peak summits, the strongest 200 per factor. Each has one negative from the same chromosome, GC-matched and clear of every peak of that factor. DAP-seq is in vitro: this is what a factor can bind, not what it occupies in a cell.

groups.known_gap: similar but non-identical sequences are not grouped unless the builder grouped them; cluster by identity before the reported runs

dropped_records.reason: a sequence carried letters its alphabet does not have, or was empty; the record was not repaired
